questions.explanation_ar: الشمس لونها أصفر (yellow). الأزرق للسما والأخضر للعشب.
questions.explanation_en: The sun is yellow (yellow). Blue is for the sky and green is for the grass.

questions.explanation_ar: السما لونها أزرق (blue) في النهار. الأحمر والأسود مش ألوان السما العادية.
questions.explanation_en: The sky is blue (blue) in the daytime. Red and black are not the usual colors of the sky.

questions.explanation_ar: العشب لونه أخضر (green). الأحمر والأصفر مش لون العشب.
questions.explanation_en: Grass is green (green). Red and yellow are not the color of grass.

questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة العربية (أحمر) معناها red، وهو لون الطماطم.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (أحمر) means red, and it is the color of the tomato.

questions.prompt: A flat drawing of a ball has the shape of a ___.
questions.explanation_ar: الشكل المسطح للكورة دايرة (circle). المربع square له 4 أضلاع، والمثلث triangle له 3.
questions.explanation_en: The flat shape of a ball is a circle (circle). A square has 4 sides, and a triangle has 3.

questions.prompt: A shape with 4 equal sides is a ___.
questions.explanation_ar: الشكل اللي له 4 أضلاع متساوية هو المربع (square). الدايرة ملهاش أضلاع، والمثلث له 3 بس.
questions.explanation_en: The shape with 4 equal sides is the square (square). A circle has no sides, and a triangle has only 3.

questions.prompt: A shape with 3 sides is a ___.
questions.explanation_ar: الشكل اللي له 3 أضلاع هو المثلث (triangle). tri معناها تلاتة.
questions.explanation_en: The shape with 3 sides is the triangle (triangle). tri means three.

questions.explanation_ar: بنسأل عن اللون بـ What color. السؤال: What color is this? يعني ده لونه إيه؟ How وWhere ليهم معاني تانية.
questions.explanation_en: We ask about color with What color. The question: What color is this? means "What is its color?" How and Where have other meanings.

questions.prompt: How many ___ do you have? — I have four.
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال How many بيسأل عن العدد، وبعده اسم جمع. الإجابة four يعني 4، فنقول pens بحرف s.
questions.explanation_en: The question How many asks about number, and it is followed by a plural noun. The answer four means 4, so we say pens with an s.

questions.explanation_ar: مع I بنستخدم have. has بتيجي مع He وShe وIt، وam مش مناسبة قبل five crayons.
questions.explanation_en: With I we use have. has goes with He, She and It, and am does not fit before five crayons.

questions.explanation_ar: مع He بنستخدم has. have بتيجي مع I وYou وWe وThey. نقول: He has three books.
questions.explanation_en: With He we use has. have goes with I, You, We and They. We say: He has three books.

questions.explanation_ar: ten + ten يعني 10 + 10 = 20، وده twenty. twelve هي 12 وthirty هي 30.
questions.explanation_en: ten + ten means 10 + 10 = 20, and that is twenty. twelve is 12 and thirty is 30.

questions.explanation_ar: بعد eleven (11) بييجي twelve (12). ten قبلها وthirteen بعد twelve.
questions.explanation_en: After eleven (11) comes twelve (12). ten is before it and thirteen is after twelve.

questions.explanation_ar: قبل fifteen (15) بييجي fourteen (14). sixteen بعدها وthirteen أبعد.
questions.explanation_en: Before fifteen (15) comes fourteen (14). sixteen is after it and thirteen is further away.

questions.explanation_ar: الرقم 18 بالكلمات eighteen. eighty يعني 80 وeight يعني 8، فخلي بالك من آخر الكلمة teen.
questions.explanation_en: The number 18 in words is eighteen. eighty means 80 and eight means 8, so watch the end of the word: teen.

questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة العربية (أصفر) معناها yellow. red أحمر وblue أزرق.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (أصفر) means yellow. red is أحمر and blue is أزرق.

questions.explanation_ar: الكلمة العربية (مربع) معناها square. circle دايرة وtriangle مثلث.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic word (مربع) means square. circle is دايرة and triangle is مثلث.

questions.explanation_ar: الجملة العربية بتقول إن لون المثلث أخضر، فنختار green. الألوان التانية مش هي المطلوبة.
questions.explanation_en: The Arabic sentence says the color of the triangle is green, so we choose green. The other colors are not the ones asked for.

questions.explanation_ar: مع She بنستخدم has. have مش بتيجي مع She، وam مش مناسبة قبل two bags.
questions.explanation_en: With She we use has. have does not go with She, and am does not fit before two bags.

questions.explanation_ar: 7 + 6 = 13، وده thirteen. twelve هي 12 وfourteen هي 14.
questions.explanation_en: 7 + 6 = 13, and that is thirteen. twelve is 12 and fourteen is 14.

questions.prompt: A flat drawing of a ball is a ___.
questions.explanation_ar: الشكل المسطح للكورة دايرة: circle.
questions.explanation_en: The flat shape of a ball is a circle: circle.

questions.explanation_ar: الشكل اللي له 4 أضلاع متساوية هو المربع: square.
questions.explanation_en: The shape with 4 equal sides is the square: square.

questions.prompt: A slice of pizza is a ___.
questions.explanation_ar: قطعة البيتزا شكلها مثلث: triangle. لها 3 أضلاع.
questions.explanation_en: A pizza slice is shaped like a triangle: triangle. It has 3 sides.

questions.explanation_ar: الموز لونه أصفر: yellow.
questions.explanation_en: A banana is yellow: yellow.

questions.explanation_ar: الفراولة لونها أحمر: red.
questions.explanation_en: A strawberry is red: red.

questions.explanation_ar: بنسأل عن لون الشنطة بـ What color. كلمة color معناها لون.
questions.explanation_en: We ask about the color of the bag with What color. The word color means لون.

questions.explanation_ar: How many بتسأل عن العدد: كام مسطرة عندك؟ many هي الكلمة الناقصة.
questions.explanation_en: How many asks about number: how many rulers do you have? many is the missing word.

questions.explanation_ar: My sister فاعل مفرد (هي)، فنستخدم has. نقول: My sister has one doll.
questions.explanation_en: My sister is a singular subject (she), so we use has. We say: My sister has one doll.

questions.explanation_ar: 10 + 2 = 12، وده twelve بالكلمات.
questions.explanation_en: 10 + 2 = 12, and that is twelve in words.

questions.explanation_ar: 10 + 10 = 20، وده twenty بالكلمات.
questions.explanation_en: 10 + 10 = 20, and that is twenty in words.

questions.explanation_ar: الحرف الناقص هو r، فتكتمل الكلمة: red. معناها أحمر.
questions.explanation_en: The missing letter is r, so the word becomes: red. It means أحمر.

questions.explanation_ar: الحرف الناقص هو b، فتكتمل الكلمة: blue. معناها أزرق.
questions.explanation_en: The missing letter is b, so the word becomes: blue. It means أزرق.

questions.explanation_ar: الحرف الناقص هو g، فتكتمل الكلمة: green. معناها أخضر.
questions.explanation_en: The missing letter is g, so the word becomes: green. It means أخضر.

questions.explanation_ar: الحرف الناقص هو c، فتكتمل الكلمة: circle. معناها دائرة.
questions.explanation_en: The missing letter is c, so the word becomes: circle. It means دائرة.

questions.explanation_ar: الحرف الناقص هو s، فتكتمل الكلمة: square. معناها مربع.
questions.explanation_en: The missing letter is s, so the word becomes: square. It means مربع.

questions.explanation_ar: الحرف الناقص هو t، فتكتمل الكلمة: ten. معناها عشرة.
questions.explanation_en: The missing letter is t, so the word becomes: ten. It means عشرة.

questions.explanation_ar: الحرف الناقص هو f، فتكتمل الكلمة: five. معناها خمسة.
questions.explanation_en: The missing letter is f, so the word becomes: five. It means خمسة.

questions.explanation_ar: الحرف الناقص هو y، فتكتمل الكلمة: yellow. معناها أصفر.
questions.explanation_en: The missing letter is y, so the word becomes: yellow. It means أصفر.

questions.explanation_en: circle means دايرة, and it has no sides.

questions.explanation_en: twelve means اثنا عشر, which is the number 12.

questions.explanation_ar: الكلمات: circle وred. اللون بييجي قبل الشكل: This is a red circle. نبدأ بحرف كبير وننهي بنقطة.
questions.explanation_en: The words: circle and red. The color comes before the shape: This is a red circle. We start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.

questions.answer: How many books do you have?
models: How many books do you have?
questions.explanation_ar: الكلمات: how many وbooks. بنسأل عن العدد: How many books do you have? وننهي الجملة بعلامة استفهام.
questions.explanation_en: The words: how many and books. We ask about number: How many books do you have? And we end the sentence with a question mark.

questions.explanation_ar: الكلمات: have وtwo bags. نبدأ بـ I وبعدها have: I have two bags. وbags جمع لأن العدد اتنين.
questions.explanation_en: The words: have and two bags. We start with I and then have: I have two bags. And bags is plural because the number is two.
